facts.business: Vapi Enterprise Limited earned revenue of Rs 2,40,56,613 during the year but the specific nature of business is not stated in the provided excerpts.

auditor.name: M I Shah And Co. (CA. Manish I. Shah)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (i) Non-compliance with Ind AS-19 on Employee Benefits regarding non-provisioning of employee benefits; (ii) Unable to form opinion on deposit of ₹2,14,04,744 paid under protest for electricity department appeal pending before Gujarat High Court, and sale of factory land with no definitive business plan for proceeds but going concern basis considered appropriate; (iii) Long-term inter-corporate borrowings of ₹47,48,076 from companies where a director has interest; (iv) Security deposit of Rs. 12,00,000 towards premises rent from M.K. Principal Pvt. Ltd. related to DGVCL appeal case.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Ind AS-19 on Employee Benefits
Uncertainty regarding deposit of ₹2,14,04,744 paid under protest for electricity department appeal
Sale of factory land with no definitive business plan for proceeds
Long-term inter-corporate borrowings from related parties
Security deposit of Rs. 12,00,000 tied to ongoing litigation
facts.related_party_note: There are no materially significant related party transactions made by the company with Promoters, Key Managerial Personnel or other designated persons which may have potential conflict with interest of the company at large. However, long-term borrowings of ₹47,48,076 from companies in which one of the Directors has an interest.
